chunks.title: Q3 Experimental Design and Analysis (LAB) — 10 points
chunks.content: AP Physics C: E&M FRQ 3 is Experimental Design and Analysis (LAB), 10 points, scored by lettered sub-points. The LAB task requires designing a procedure, planning a linearizing analysis, and reasoning from data/graphs. Q3 topic: an electric-circuit experiment (current measurements, resistance/capacitance determination). Points reward: a valid, replicable procedure with correct electrical measurements; a correct graphing/linearization plan; correct slope/intercept interpretation (tying it to a physical quantity); and data-supported conclusions. Common failure: a procedure missing a measurement/control; plotting quantities that do not linearize the relationship; not connecting slope/intercept to the target physical quantity.
